name: Loving Unconditionally
overview: Scripture calls believers to love unconditionally, exemplified by Christ’s command to love even our enemies and do good to those who hate us (Luke 6:27). This love mirrors God’s sacrificial love for the world, demonstrated by giving His only Son so that believers may have eternal life (John 3:16). Jesus further instructs us to love one another as He has loved us, a love so great it is willing to lay down life for friends (John 15:12-13). Recognizing our own sinfulness and judgment of others without mercy (Romans 2:1; 3:23) underscores the need for this grace-filled, unconditional love in the Christian life.
